caption: A child strikes a large temple bell with a wooden beam, and the bell's rim shimmers and the bell sways on its hanger.
expectation: The shimmer and sway begin at the strike and die away over several seconds; the bell is still before.

caption: A boy strikes a horseshoe hanging from a string with a nail, and the horseshoe rings and quivers on its string.
expectation: The quiver and swing begin at the strike and fade over a few seconds; the horseshoe is still before.

caption: A cook bangs a wok with a ladle, and the wok rings and quivers on its stand.
expectation: The quiver starts at the bang and fades within a second or two.

caption: A gymnast dismounts from a balance beam, and the beam shivers along its length before settling.
expectation: The shiver starts as she pushes off and dies away quickly; the beam is still before and after.

caption: A man flicks the blade of a handsaw held by its handle, and the blade wobbles in a blur before going still.
expectation: The blur is widest at the tip right after the flick and shrinks to stillness; the handle stays sharp.

caption: A drummer hits a hanging tom-tom, and the head dips and shivers before returning flat.
expectation: The first dip is deepest and the rebounds shrink; the head is flat within a couple of seconds.

caption: A child kicks a chain-link fence, and the mesh shivers outward from the kick along the panel.
expectation: The shiver spreads from the kick point and dies away within seconds; the fence is still before.

caption: A bass guitarist plays a low note through an amplifier, and the water in a glass on the amp shivers into ripples.
expectation: The ripples appear with the note and vanish when it stops; the glass does not slide off.

caption: A garbage truck idles outside a house, and a hanging wind chime by the door trembles and tinkles while the engine runs.
expectation: The trembling lasts while the truck idles and stops after it drives away; the chime is still in quiet air.

caption: A door is slammed in a hallway, and a framed mirror on the adjacent wall rocks on its hook before hanging still.
expectation: The rocking begins at the slam and dies out over a few seconds; the mirror does not move before.

caption: A brass band plays in a square, and the loose glass of a nearby café window buzzes with the tuba notes.
expectation: The buzzing appears on the low notes and stops between them; the window is still when the band stops.

caption: A cement mixer rumbles beside a garden wall, and pebbles on the wall's top shiver and shift.
expectation: The pebbles move only while the mixer runs and settle when it stops.

caption: A church organ plays a deep pedal note, and a hymn book on a nearby pew shivers and slides to the edge.
expectation: The book moves only while the low note sounds and stops when it ends.

caption: A heavy freight train passes a level crossing, and the coins in a cup holder of a waiting car rattle.
expectation: The rattling starts as the train arrives, is strongest as it passes, and stops once it has gone.

caption: A moped idles at a kerb, and its exhaust pipe quivers visibly until the engine is switched off.
expectation: The quiver lasts as long as the engine runs and stops within a moment of it being cut.

caption: A phone on vibrate buzzes on a nightstand and works its way to the edge before the alarm is silenced.
expectation: The phone moves in small jerks only while buzzing and stops the moment it is silenced.

caption: A violinist plays a fast passage, and the bowed strings blur under the bow and sharpen as the bow lifts.
expectation: Only the strings under the moving bow blur; they are sharp when the bow is off them.

caption: A cook runs a hand-held blender in a jug of soup, and the shaft blurs and the jug trembles until she releases the button.
expectation: The blur and trembling exist only while the button is held and stop when it is released.

caption: A carillon bell in a tower is struck by its hammer, and the hammer swings back while the bell's rim quivers.
expectation: The hammer moves only to strike and retreat; the quiver begins at the strike and fades.

caption: A jackhammer is started on a pavement, and its bit blurs and the whole tool shudders in the worker's hands until he releases the trigger.
expectation: The shuddering lasts as long as the trigger is held and stops when it is released.
